description: Build a new website in the person's iter0 account from a brief, a reference URL they are allowed to use, or a directionId from their Show 3 set. Costs 1 credit. The first call returns a price quote and starts nothing; the build starts only when the person confirms that quote, in the iter0 card or by saying yes in chat, and iter0_confirm_paid_action redeems it. The iter0 card shows the price, the build's progress and the finished site, and updates itself. A running build is not a finished site. Covers only the person's own iter0 websites and designs, not general design, colour, logo or branding advice, hosting elsewhere or domains. iter0 does not sell credits or take payment through ChatGPT.

inputSchema.description: MCP body limit: 2,250,000 UTF-8 bytes. Serialized argument limit: 2,100,000 UTF-8 bytes. String maxLength values are character ceilings; UTF-8 byte limits also apply.

approvalId.description: Compatibility receipt for a quote already confirmed in iter0. New quotes are redeemed with iter0_confirm_paid_action.

bindUrl.description: Optional customer evidence source. At most 2,048 UTF-8 bytes.

briefBuild.description: Develop the launch brief before building.

cloneUrl.description: Optional reference website. At most 2,048 UTF-8 bytes.

confirmationVersion.description: Compatibility marker sent by direction cards. It does not authorize spending.

directionId.description: A directionId from iter0_get_design_set_status; builds that exact direction, with no prompt or reference arguments.

prompt.description: The website goal and customer context. At most 32,000 UTF-8 bytes.

quoteOnly.description: Return the price only; never starts or charges a build.

variant.description: Normally empty. A new value such as "2" requests a fresh build of a request already made (for example after a failed build, or another version); it is quoted and uses a credit.

name: iter0_create_site

quoteId.description: The reference of the price quote the person accepted.

title: Build a website
